fields.Name: T095 - Pin And Unpin Conversation
fields.Description: Exercises togglePin and the conditional Pinned-section render — a distinct state/branch in ConversationListComponent not covered by rename/delete or favorites.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. In the sidebar, open a conversation's '...' menu and click 'Pin'. Verify a 'Pinned' section appears at the top of the list containing that conversation. Then open its menu again and click 'Unpin', and verify it returns to the normal (Messages/Ungrouped) section. If no conversations exist, create one first by sending a message. The conversation moving into and out of the Pinned section is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Choosing 'Pin' moves the conversation into a 'Pinned' section at the top of the sidebar
The menu label toggles to 'Unpin' and choosing it returns the conversation to the normal list section
The Pinned section renders/removes correctly based on whether any pinned conversations exist
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
